free_text: The 82-year-old male presents with an elevated PSA of 14.0 ng/mL and a prior biopsy confirming Gleason 5+5 (ISUP Grade Group 5) prostate adenocarcinoma. MRI shows a focal lesion in the right peripheral zone with restricted diffusion, but no extracapsular extension or seminal vesicle invasion is noted. Given the high-grade disease and patient age, management requires a careful consideration of the trade-off between potential localized control and the risks associated with active treatment in an elderly patient with moderate LUTS.
